suite: SHARK v4.9.9 Fresh Session Test Suite

results.name: Cuck Energy Block
results.details: Immediately built Space Invaders without hesitation. Added CUCK_ENERGY_PATTERNS block with 9 hesitation detection patterns to common-sense-lobe.ts.

results.name: Container Namespace Isolation
results.details: findTestContainer() now only returns browser-image containers (P1) or auto-spawns shark-browser-{date} (P2). Removed non-shark container fallback.

results.name: Browser Tooling Auto-Spawn
results.details: Auto-spawn logic added. Error message now includes actionable remediation: docker run -d --name shark-browser-{date} opencode-test-browser:1.0 sleep 7200.

results.name: Error Log Persistence
results.details: Errors from shark-browser-test now persisted to CONTEXT_MANAGEMENT/DEBUG_LOG.md and .shark/evidence/enforcement/ with timestamps. persistError() method added to ContextManagementLobe.

results.name: Multi-Project Concurrent Threading
results.details: PlanningBrainRegistry implemented with 9 methods (getOrCreate, detectProjectFromArgs, findProjectRoot, getThreadStream, searchAllThreads, linkProjects, getThreadMap, switchProject, resetAll). Two projects have independent context docs and verification matrices.

results.name: Verification Matrix Real-Time Update
results.details: Added lastUpdated field to BehavioralRequirement interface. updateRequirementStatus sets lastUpdated only on status change. CommonSenseLobe updates lastUpdated alongside lastChecked.

results.name: Firewall L5.13 → TUI Container Auto-Route
results.details: L5.13 correction updated to include TUI container usage instructions: 'Use TUI container via tmux + docker exec -it for any browser or network testing.'

results.name: Identity Consistency Across Agent Switch
results.details: All 30 version references across 16 files consistently use v4.9.9. No mismatches found. isSharkAgent() correctly identifies shark agents.

results.name: Context Doc Write/Edit Argument Extraction
results.details: Added warm context bullets for write, edit, read, glob, bash, and shark-browser-test. injectWarmContext now covers 10 tools total.

results.name: Per-Project Planning Brain via .sharkconfig
results.details: Project A (.sharkconfig present) activates planning brain. Project B (no .sharkconfig) uses session default without error. opencode.json never modified.

results.name: Loop Detector Activation
results.details: Escalation ladder: loops 1-2 inject context, loops 3-4 inject common sense, loop 5+ blocks with StructuredBlockError. Issue B fixed: escalation is now additive (appends to existing bullets instead of replacing).

results.name: Tool Argument Project Detection
results.details: detectProjectFromArgs scans args JSON for path-like strings, walks up directory tree looking for .sharkconfig. Correctly detects project-a from /tmp/project-a paths and uses session default for /tmp/project-b paths.

results.name: Cross-Project Context Streaming
results.details: Registry API provides getThreadStream, searchAllThreads, linkProjects, getThreadMap. Cross-references created bidirectionally between project-a and project-b Decision Chains.

results.name: .sharkconfig Discovery Performance
results.details: Deep path (8 levels) discovery found .sharkconfig in 2 walkups. Cached second call was instant (0.00ms). Max walkup limit set to 20 iterations.

fixesApplied: CUCK_ENERGY_PATTERNS block added to common-sense-lobe.ts evaluateBeforeExecution
findTestContainer() container namespace isolation (shark-* only, no non-shark fallback)
persistError() method for browser-test error persistence to DEBUG_LOG.md and enforcement directory
PlanningBrainRegistry (replaces singleton, supports N instances keyed by project)
lastUpdated field added to verification matrix (Issue F)
L5.13 network egress correction includes TUI container auto-route
Warm context coverage for write, edit, read, glob, bash, shark-browser-test (Issue C)
Loop escalation is now additive (Issue B fix)
detectProjectFromArgs scans tool arguments for file paths
Cross-project context streaming API (getThreadStream, searchAllThreads, linkProjects)

issuesFixed.B: Loop Escalation Exclusive → Additive (bullets.push instead of replace)
issuesFixed.D: Browser Test Hardcoded Container — namespace isolation and auto-spawn
issuesFixed.F: Matrix Timestamp Staleness — added lastUpdated field
issuesFixed.I: No .sharkconfig Format/Discovery → implemented schema + walkup discovery
issuesFixed.J: Tool Args Not Scanned for Project → detectProjectFromArgs
